I should have immediately discarded 'a' and 't', kept 'e' and 'r' in different slots, and tried a completely different word like "bears" or "fears" to test the remaining letters. Next time, I will analyze the yellow and red letters after every guess and only submit a new word that incorporates the confirmed letters in new positions while excluding the red ones.
